Name: Meshullam, Son of Shephathiah
Summary: Son of Shephathiah son of Reuel son of Ibnijah, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:8: Son of Shephathiah son of Reuel son of Ibnijah, of the sons of Benjamin dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Meshullam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
